quarantined_proxy_experiments.audit_finding: In TropicalCycloneDataset, 2-channel radiative rasters were synthesized using an analytical vortex temperature formula: T_B = g(wind_kts). Because the raster structure was derived from the target label, neural models learned to invert this generator formula rather than extract predictive features from genuine spaceborne satellite observations. Consequently, the low test MAE (~1.7-1.8 kts) and near-perfect correlation (0.999) are mathematical artifacts of formula inversion and MUST NOT be cited as evidence of real-world spaceborne predictive performance.

dataset_sample_reconciliation.inclusion_exclusion_filter: Archive contains 1,859 historical storms dating back to 1842. Filtering for modern satellite era (seasons >= 2000) yields 265 candidate storms. Excluding storms with zero recorded wind speed or coordinates outside valid geophysical bounds yields exactly 157 unique storms and 7,229 observations: 4,973 train (109 storms), 1,285 validation (23 storms), and 971 test (25 storms).

metrics_reconciliation.macro_vs_weighted_f1_explanation: Macro F1 represents the unweighted arithmetic mean across all 5 IMD categories. Because Category 4 (Super Cyclonic Storms, >= 120 kts) is exceptionally rare in the North Indian Ocean (< 1.5% of observations), per-class recall for the extreme minority class lowers the unweighted macro average. In contrast, Weighted F1 weights each class by its support, accurately reflecting overall classification reliability across the actual operational cyclone frequency distribution.

validation_vs_test_reconciliation.explanation: Checkpoint metadata files recorded validation set metrics during training early stopping; benchmark reports record held-out test set metrics.
